## A4 3-Day Follow-up (with approval)
Every 60 min: CRM_Leads rows with **Reply_Status = Sent**, **Reply_Sent_At** > 3 days (`TEST_DAYS = 3` at top of Pick leads node — set to `0` for testing), no Followup_Status, and Odoo lead still in **New / Qualified** (max 3/run).
Gemini writes a short polite follow-up → sheet **Followup_Status = Awaiting approval** → approval bot sends **✅ Send / ✏️ Edit** (`fsend:` / `fedit:`).
A3b handles the button taps.
